newsitem.title: RUSSIA: My heart "works like a clock" after op -Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: My heart "works like a clock" after op -Yeltsin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin was quoted as saying on Wednesday his heart "works like a clock" and he could stand the heat of the Russian banya (sauna) better than the cardiac surgeon who had operated on him.

Interfax news agency quoted the president as saying Renat Akchurin, who performed the quintuple bypass on Yeltsin's heart on November 5, had visited the Russian leader at the Volzhsky Utyos holiday retreat in central Russia.

"In order to prove to him that my heart works like a clock, I took him to the banya," Yeltsin said. "First he worked on me with a twig and then I worked on him. We found out that his pulse was quicker than mine after that."
A twig of birches is traditionally used in the Russian banya -- usually more steamy than a sauna -- to improve blood circulation.
The 66-year old Kremlin leader, in the second year of his second and constitutionally last term, has made a remarkable recovery since surgery and double pneumonia in January.
He has been on holiday since early July and as well as fishing and business meetings, has even started to play his favourite game of tennis for the first time since his illness.
"I feel well and I am having a good rest," he said.
